title: Bitcoin Movie Enigma

prize.note: single P2WPKH escrow, one funding transaction

target_format: BIP39 24 words (English), most likely BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/i (script type v0_p2wpkh), no passphrase stated

derivation.summary: identify the 34 movies shown in panel order, transform each title into an English BIP39 word, drop 10 'intruder' words identified from an IMDb metadata field, and derive the resulting 24-word mnemonic to a P2WPKH address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vectors (12-word and 24-word 'abandon' vectors), since no solved sibling exists for this puzzle

difficulty_note: all 34 films are identified, though panels 8 and 11 carry open evidentiary tension rather than clean confirmation; panel 8 was briefly corrected 2026-08-19 to Shutter Island (independently sourced via Bing Visual Search) then reverted to The Goonies per user instruction, with Shutter Island kept as a live secondary probability -- Goonies has no literal BIP39 word (uses the guessed, unverified 'chunk'), Shutter Island has a literal one ('island'); panel 11 was corrected the same day from Godzilla to Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls on the user's own direct identification, but an independent check found no documented scene in that film matching the still's content (only an unrelated spoken catchphrase), while Godzilla's beach-shipwreck scene remains independently sourced -- both panels are carried forward as-instructed with the tension documented, not resolved; a full 4,752-candidate cross covering both panel 8 hypotheses plus the corrected panel 11 (all other open choices included) was run against the escrow 2026-08-19 with 0 matches, which does not kill any single hypothesis inside it since Sharknado and Raiders of the Lost Ark are still guessed in that same space

tested_total.note: 0 matches; Raiders' guess list expanded from 11 to 17 words 2026-08-19 (added soft/rail/raise/risk/other/rather, of which only 'soft' has any textual connection to the title); this is the most exhaustive Raiders word sweep run so far, and the first to cover both live panel 8 hypotheses plus the corrected panel 11 together

leads.title: find real words for Sharknado and Raiders of the Lost Ark
settle panel 8 (Goonies vs Shutter Island) and panel 11 (Godzilla vs Ace Ventura) with decisive evidence
if panel 8 is ever settled as Shutter Island, resolve the resulting Scorsese-pair complication in the director/lead-actor intruder criterion

third_party_material: the 34 movie panels are individual frames from third-party films, not original material by the author; I do not reproduce them here and link to the author's still-live site instead
